lines.text: Many learners say: My father learned me to swim.
Better: My father taught me to swim.
Learn is for the student. Teach is for the person giving lessons.
Taught! My uncle taught me to drive.

data.wrong: My father learned me to swim.
data.right: My father taught me to swim.
data.why: Learn is for the student. Teach is for the person giving lessons.
